title: Representable presheaves are sheaves on the small etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $T_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $X\to T$ be a $T$-scheme. The presheaf $h_X$ on $T_{\Et}$ defined by $h_X(U)=\operatorname{Mor}_T(U,X)$ is a sheaf of sets for the etale topology: for every etale covering family $(U_i\to U)_i$, morphisms $U_i\to X$ which agree after pullback to $U_i\times_UU_j$ glue uniquely to a morphism $U\to X.

proof.text: Mathlib proves that the fpqc topology is subcanonical (the descent assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent]). In Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Proetale, etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology and the subcanonical proetaleTopology instance give etaleTopology.Subcanonical by Subcanonical.of_le. The instance subcanonical_over then makes yoneda.obj (Over.mk (X → T)) a sheaf on etaleTopology.over T: it glues underlying scheme morphisms and checks the structure map by uniqueness, exactly as in the original descent argument. The fully faithful inclusion Etale.forget T preserves finite limits, hence is representably flat. Scheme.locallyCoverDense_of_le T le_rfl and Functor.coverPreserving_restrictedTopology show it preserves covers from smallEtaleTopology T to etaleTopology.over T. Functor.isContinuous_iff_coverPreserving therefore makes this inclusion continuous. Apply op_comp_isSheaf_of_isSheaf_type to restrict the representable sheaf, then IsSheaf.isSheafFor to the given covering presieve. All these categorical transport statements are proved in Mathlib; no new descent lemma is needed.
